s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we look for things that go!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! I love to go!

s03_01.text: How many wheels can you see?

s07_01.text: The light is red. Do we stop or go?

s09_02.text: One, two, three! Three train cars!

s11_02.text: A boat floats on the water.

s12_01.text: Does a boat go on the road or on the water?

s13_02.text: A plane flies in the sky.

s14_01.text: Can you fly like a plane?

s18_01.text: Hello, friends! I go across the sky!

s20_01.text: Which one flies in the sky?

s22_01.text: The bus and the car go on the road.

s22_02.text: The train goes on the tracks. The boat goes on the water.

s22_03.text: And the plane goes in the sky!

s23_01.text: Thank you for riding with us!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!

s24_01.text: You know so many things that go!
